# opnsense_bind_settings (Resource)

Manages BIND global settings. This singleton must be imported with `bind_settings` before use. Attributes omitted from configuration retain their imported upstream values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_bind_settings.main
  id = "bind_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_bind_settings" "main" {
  enabled               = true
  listen_ipv4           = ["192.0.2.53", "10.0.0.1"]
  listen_ipv6           = ["2001:db8::53"]
  port                  = 53
  hide_hostname         = true
  hide_version          = true
  enable_rate_limiting  = true
  rate_limit_count      = 20
  rate_limit_exceptions = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disable_ipv6` (Boolean) Disable IPv6 support in BIND.
- `disable_prefetch` (Boolean)
- `dnssec_validation` (String) Legacy global DNSSEC validation mode used only when no views are enabled.
- `enable_rate_limiting` (Boolean) Enable BIND response rate limiting.
- `enable_rpz` (Boolean) Enable response policy zones.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether BIND is enabled.
- `filter_aaaa_acl` (Set of String) Addresses or networks subject to AAAA filtering.
- `filter_aaaa_ipv4` (Boolean)
- `filter_aaaa_ipv6` (Boolean)
- `forwarders` (Set of String) Legacy global forwarding servers. Per-view forwarders take precedence when views are enabled.
- `hide_hostname` (Boolean)
- `hide_version` (Boolean)
- `legacy_allow_query_acl_ids` (Set of String) Legacy global query ACLs used only when no views are enabled.
- `legacy_allow_transfer_acl_ids` (Set of String) Legacy global transfer ACLs used only when no views are enabled.
- `legacy_recursion_acl_ids` (Set of String) Legacy global recursion ACLs used only when no views are enabled.
- `listen_ipv4` (Set of String) IPv4 addresses on which BIND listens.
- `listen_ipv6` (Set of String) IPv6 addresses on which BIND listens.
- `log_level` (String)
- `log_size_mb` (Number) Maximum size of each BIND log file in MiB.
- `max_cache_size_percent` (Number) Maximum BIND cache size as a percentage of memory.
- `port` (Number) DNS listen port.
- `query_source` (String) Optional IPv4 source address for recursive queries.
- `query_source_ipv6` (String) Optional IPv6 source address for recursive queries.
- `rate_limit_count` (Number) Responses per second allowed before rate limiting.
- `rate_limit_exceptions` (Set of String) Addresses or networks exempt from response rate limiting.
- `transfer_source` (String) Optional IPv4 source address for zone transfers.
- `transfer_source_ipv6` (String) Optional IPv6 source address for zone transfers.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `bind_settings`.
